newsitem.title: USA: NY Dormitory Auth gets okay on debt swap - paper.
newsitem.headline: NY Dormitory Auth gets okay on debt swap - paper.

text.p: New York State Dormitory Authority got approval from State University of New York to swap about $250 million of fixed-rated bonds for variable rate debt, the Albany Times Union reported Wednesday.
The swap was expected to cut lower interest rates by about one percent, saving the state $3 million to $4 million a year.
The state authority was expected to choose one or two bids from four Wall Street firms that want to broker the swap.
The firms are Lehman Brothers, Goldman Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co and J.P. Morgan Securities Inc, the paper said.
